description: WFC over box-drawing pipe tiles (corners and straights) that connect into paths, flood-filled by connected component color, scrolling horizontally forever
notable: Colors propagate along topologically connected pipe runs, so each contiguous path reads as one hue; infinite left-scroll regenerates one collapsed column at a time

description: 32x32 grid of circles whose radii are driven by a summed multi-frequency sine field, drawn over a hairline grid with dark outlines
notable: The 'wobbly' function nests sines inside sines with a 45-degree rotated coordinate pair for a plaid-like breathing field

description: Variant of wobbly-grid using outlined squares instead of circles, side length modulated by the same nested multi-frequency sine field over a hairline grid
notable: Same wobbly field as wobbly-grid but mapped to square size; playhead is passed through an extra sin() giving a ping-pong rather than looping sweep

description: A dense row of overlapping circles traces a sine-driven wobbly band across the canvas, each circle colored by a gradient sampled along the axis
notable: Randomly picks horizontal or vertical orientation and two summed sine frequencies (a and 6-a) so each run reads differently; colors from a homegrown subtractive-color generator

description: A rotating hexagon fan-filled with Bresenham lines whose pixels XOR-toggle on a 256x256 field, producing black-on-white moire interference
notable: Overlapping XOR line strokes cancel where they cross, so the solid fan dissolves into banded interference that rotates with the hexagon

description: Static XOR field: a fan of Bresenham lines from one corner to every column top toggles pixels, yielding a black-and-white moire lattice
notable: Simplest of the xor series: a single-frame corner fan whose overlaps XOR into a periodic interference weave

description: Two Lissajous curves rendered as XOR-toggled line segments on a 256x256 field, animating into shifting white-on-black interference figures
notable: Chords span a spread of Lissajous phase offsets and XOR against each other, so the harmonic figure appears as negative-space bands rather than a drawn line

description: Circle-packed field of many Lissajous figures at varied scales, each drawn as XOR-toggled line chords, animating as white-on-black interference clusters
notable: pack-spheres lays out up to 50 Lissajous cells with phase offsets keyed to index, so each packed disc animates its own harmonic pattern

description: Three phase-shifted Lissajous figures each tagged red, green, or blue write into a shared XOR field, producing overlapping additive-primary interference
notable: Each channel's XOR overwrites the cell value with its own index, so RGB primaries compete for pixels rather than blending, giving hard-edged color separation

description: A rotating 12-sided polygon fan-filled with XOR lines, then per-column pixel shifting displaces alternating columns for a glitched moire
notable: After the XOR fan renders, each column's pixels shift left or right by parity and frame, smearing the interference into a scanline-like displacement

description: A 12-sided polygon fan-filled with XOR lines whose center travels across the canvas as it rotates, dragging the interference pattern with it
notable: Center x is driven by playhead so the rotating polygon sweeps left-to-right, its moire fan moving like a traveling wavefront

description: A rotating triangle fan-filled with XOR-toggled Bresenham lines on a 256x256 field, dissolving the solid triangle into black-and-white moire
notable: Only vertex 0's fan of 50 lines is drawn, so the triangle fills as a single-corner sweep whose XOR overlaps read as concentric interference
